[[Spawning Power]] | damagetype = [[Fire damage]] }} [[Kerrsh's Staff]] is a [[unique item|unique]] [[staff]] given as a quest reward by [[Kerrsh]] for completing [[The Path to Revelations]]. == Stats == :[[Energy]] +10 :[[Fire damage]]: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Divine Favor]]) :Fire damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Fast Casting]]) :Fire damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Soul Reaping]]) :Fire damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Energy Storage]]) :Fire damage: 11-22 (Requires 9 [[Spawning Power]]) :[[HSR|Halves skill recharge]] of [[spell]]s (Chance: 20%) :[[Energy]] +5 (while [[Health]] is above 50%) :Health +60 ==Replica== Except for the visual appearance and [[damage type]], it is possible to create a replica of this staff with the same stats. Replicas will cause the damage type associated with the inherent [[attribute]]. Create a replica with the following: *One of the following staves with the appropriate attribute: **[[Destroyer Staff]] from crafter [[Balthor Coalforge]] **[[Imperial Staff]] from collector [[Shen Xi]] **[[Tormented Staff]] from collector [[Deacon of Whispers]] *[[Perfect]] [[Hale]] [[Staff Head]] *Perfect [[Staff Wrapping]] [[of Fortitude]] OR *One of the following staves with the appropriate attribute: **[[Asuran Staff]] from crafter [[Nojj]] **[[Balthazar's Staff]] from collector [[Zaishen Weapon Master]] **[[Deldrimor Staff]] from crafter [[Grand Mason Stonecleaver]] **[[Norn Staff]] from crafter [[Keti]] **[[Oppressor's Staff]] from collector [[Lionguard (collector)|Lionguard]] **[[Raven Staff]] from crafter [[Hulen Hairyback]] **[[Staff of Purity]] from collector [[Iza Yoi]] **Staff from crafters [[Asa]], [[Bolereh]], [[Derrick]], [[Rahmdah]], [[Soros]], or [[Sende]] **[[Charr Staff]] from collector [[Tuomas]] (requires [[Bonus Mission Pack]]) **[[Mursaat Staff]] from collector [[Diane]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack) **[[Tengu Staff]] from collector [[Akemi]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack) **[[Undead Staff]] from collector [[Archivist of Whispers]] (requires Bonus Mission Pack) *Perfect Hale Staff Head *Perfect Staff Wrapping of Fortitude *Perfect [["Hale and Hearty"]] inscription ==Unique counterparts== *[[Divine Shadow Staff]] has stats identical to this item except for the additional damage [[attribute]] requirements. *The [[Divine Favor]] version of the [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)]] has stats identical to this item except for the additional damage [[attribute]] requirements. *The [[Fast Casting]] version of the [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Chaos damage]] and requires [[Fast Casting]] only. *The [[Soul Reaping]] version of the [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]] and requires [[Soul Reaping]] only. *The [[Energy Storage]] version of the [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Chaos damage]] and requires [[Energy Storage]] only. *The [[Spawning Power]] version of the [[Deldrimor Staff (unique)]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Lightning damage]] and requires [[Spawning Power]] only. *[[Grim Shadow Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]] and requires [[Soul Reaping]] only. *[[The Mindstealer]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Chaos damage]] and requires [[Illusion Magic]] only. *[[Inspired Shadow Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Chaos damage]] and requires [[Inspiration Magic]] only. *[[Moteh's Lightning Spire]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Lightning damage]] and requires [[Air Magic]] only. *[[Shekoss' Staff]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Earth damage]] and requires [[Earth Magic]] only. *[[Everlasting Shadow Staff]] and [[Prismatic Staff]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Chaos damage]] and require [[Energy Storage]] only. *[[Exuro's Will]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it requires [[Fire Magic]] only. *[[Staff of Ruin]] has stats nearly identical to this item; however, it inflicts [[Dark damage]] and requires [[Communing]] only. *[[Alsin's Walking Stick]] and [[Ritualistic Shadow Staff]] have stats nearly identical to this item; however, they inflict [[Lightning damage]] and require [[Spawning Power]] only. ==Notes== * Other weapons with this appearance: **{{any}} [[Gilded Staff]] (PvP reward) * Fast Casting, Soul Reaping, Energy Storage, and Spawning Power staves do not [[Staff#Damage types of other staves|usually deal]] fire damage.
